DEFECT_BOSS.status:
State Machine
Whenever the Defect generates a Status card, a copy of it is also added to your discard pile.
The first time you draw a Status card each turn, Exhaust it, draw 1 card and gain 1 Energy.

DEFECT_BOSS.special:
Biased Cognition
Whenever you play a Power card other than Ceremony or Burning Study, the Defect gains 1 Focus, and its Strength and Focus are always equal (a change in one applies to the other).
WARNING: Hailstorm deals sourceless damage - a summon with "Die for You" will not absorb it for you.
DEFECT_BOSS.dark:
Coolant
At the start of combat, add 2 Luminesce to your draw pile and hand.
At the end of your turn, if a Luminesce is still in your hand, none of the Defect's Dark orbs trigger their passive this turn.
DEFECT_BOSS.synthesis:
Synthesis
The Defect gains 3 Artifact at the start of combat.
IRONCLAD_BOSS.anger:
Inflamed Crowd (Global)
Whenever the Ironclad plays Anger, a copy of Anger is also added to every player's discard pile.
Whenever a player plays Anger, the Ironclad loses 3 Strength this turn.
IRONCLAD_BOSS.dominate:
Dominate
Whenever the Ironclad applies Vulnerable, also apply 1 Weak.
SILENT_BOSS.special:
Sleeve Trick
Each turn, the first time you play a card costing 2 or more, add 3 Shivs to the Silent's hand.
SILENT_BOSS.brewer:
Brewing
The Silent keeps her original potion slots and uses potions in combat.
Whenever she would lose HP while she has Block, she loses that much Block instead.
When her Fairy in a Bottle triggers, all debuffs on her are removed.
WARNING: Explosive Ampoule and Serpent Form deal sourceless damage - a summon with "Die for You" will not absorb it for you.
SILENT_BOSS.sly:
Shared Fate
The first time the Silent discards a card each turn, discard a card of your choice at the start of your next turn.
SILENT_BOSS.special_act2:
Poisoned Strike
Poison now resolves at the end of your turn, and its damage can be blocked.
Whenever unblocked damage is dealt to an opponent, move 1 Poison from the damage dealer to the target.
NECROBINDER_BOSS.special:
Not Yet
Whenever your Block would be lost at the start of your turn, it instead offsets an equal amount of Doom.
When your turn is about to end, if Doom would kill you, your Block and your summons' HP immediately offset Doom until it would no longer kill you.
NECROBINDER_BOSS.soul_bound:
Soulbound
Cards you draw during a turn also count as cards drawn by the Necrobinder (increasing Automation's counter and Death March's damage).
REGENT_BOSS.special:
Know Thy Place
Whenever the Regent loses 25 HP in a single turn, he loses 5 Forge, then all players lose 1 Strength for this turn. Up to 3 times per turn.
REGENT_BOSS.stellar:
Stellar Gathering
Whenever the Regent gains Retain, all players gain Retain and Energy next turn.
Warning: Black Hole deals unblockable-from-no-source damage; summons with "Die For You" will not absorb it.
REGENT_BOSS.resonance:
Resonance
Whenever a player generates a card in combat, the Regent's Pillar of Creation triggers as well.
WARNING: The Bomb deals sourceless damage - a summon with "Die for You" will not absorb it for you.
REGENT_BOSS.comet:
Comet
Whenever the Regent generates Debris, it is added to your draw pile instead.
Whenever you play Debris, all players gain 10 Block, all Weak and Vulnerable are removed from all players, and all enemies lose 10 HP.
NECROBINDER_BOSS.borrowed_time:
Borrowed Time
Whenever you spend 10 [img]res://images/packed/sprite_fonts/necrobinder_energy_icon.png[/img], your cards cost 1 more [img]res://images/packed/sprite_fonts/necrobinder_energy_icon.png[/img] this turn, and the Necrobinder gains 1 [img]res://images/packed/sprite_fonts/necrobinder_energy_icon.png[/img].
IRONCLAD_BOSS.pact:
Burning Pact
Cards the Ironclad creates through Juggling have Ethereal and Exhaust.
IRONCLAD_BOSS.boulder:
Primal Force
Whenever the Ironclad plays Giant Rock, he gains 1 Strength and 2 Plated Armor.
If Giant Rock deals unblocked damage to you, you gain 1 Weak.
IRONCLAD_BOSS.rending:
Reap
Whenever the Ironclad deals unblocked damage, he heals for that amount.
REGENT_BOSS.conqueror:
Conqueror
Whenever the Regent puts a card on top of the draw pile, all players' next Attack deals 50% less damage.
WARNING: Mr. Struggles deals sourceless damage - a summon with "Die for You" will not absorb it for you.
NECROBINDER_BOSS.undying:
Undying
Osty cannot die. It still absorbs unblocked attack damage for the Necrobinder until it is down to 1 HP; after that the Necrobinder takes the damage Osty would have taken instead.
WARNING: Osty is a summon - summons with "Die for You" do not absorb damage for each other.
SILENT_BOSS.well_laid:
Well-Laid Plans
The first time the Silent draws a card costing 3 each turn, she retains it.
Her [gold]Murder[/gold] only gains damage from drawing cards while it is retained in her hand.
DEFECT_BOSS.one_for_all:
One for All
The Defect's [gold]All for One[/gold] only puts 0-cost [gold]Attacks[/gold] from its [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] into its [gold]Hand[/gold], instead of every 0-cost card.
Whenever one of its cards returns from its Discard Pile to its Hand, ALL units gain 1 [gold]Strength[/gold].
REGENT_BOSS.orbital:
Orbital Bombardment
You start combat with 1 stack of [gold]Spectrum Shift[/gold].
The Regent is [gold]Stunned[/gold] on turn 1; after playing [gold]Bombardment[/gold] he stays Stunned while it [gold]re-fires every turn[/gold] from his [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold].
On your 5th turn in which you played a Colorless card he wakes up — and the [gold]Bombardment[/gold] starts hitting HIM instead.
REGENT_BOSS.minion:
Call to Arms
Whenever the Regent plays a Minion card, if he has fewer than 2 Minions, summon the matching Minion instead.
Whenever the Regent gains Strength from a card, his other allies gain the same amount.
DEFECT_BOSS.thunder:
Lightning Rod
Every time you play 3 cards in a turn, the Defect loses 1 Focus this turn (1 per 3 cards, restored at end of turn).
DEFECT_BOSS.rainbow:
Rainbow
Every 5 orbs the Defect channels, it gains 1 Focus. Its Dark orbs never trigger their passive.
WARNING: Glass orbs deal sourceless damage - a summon with "Die for You" will not absorb it for you.
WARNING: Metronome deals 30 sourceless damage to all enemies every 5 orbs channeled - a summon with "Die for You" will not absorb it for you.
